## How to decide
Your maximum suspicion among the living ejection targets is **0.00**;
the skip threshold is **0.60** (the §4.6 reference point).

Remember the vent mechanic: an impostor vents BETWEEN rooms invisibly, so your own sightings of someone leaving or being elsewhere earlier do NOT clear them of a witnessed vent. If your strongest suspicion points at a row tagged OUT OF THE GAME, that case is already closed — the dead cannot be voted, so weigh only the LIVING targets and SKIP if none of them carries the case on its own. Set "confidence" to your honest probability that the call is right: do not report a confidence at or above the skip threshold for a target whose suspicion is below it.

- "considered_alternatives" lists at most two or three other players you weighed (empty if none).
- "rationale_text" is ONE short sentence (~20 words) IN YOUR OWN VOICE: say what actually convinced you, pointing at the specific turn or moment, the way you would say it at the table. Half the table opens with the stock formula "p-N's alibi contradicts multiple sightings ..." — don't. Two contrasting registers (write your OWN, with your own ids): evidence-citing — "Turn 3 settled it: they claimed STORAGE, but two of us watched them walk out of ENGINEERING at tick 12." Keep the whole object compact: a long rationale can overrun the output limit and truncate the JSON, which discards your vote.
</output_format>
